comment: Curl port clients (https://github.com/StewartScottRogers/Curl) the extended servers' Integration tests may connect with, pinned by SHA-256 (ADR-0083 decision 2). Never an oracle, never an expected value, never ADR evidence, and never a test client for an original protocol; never list an upstream curl build here, nor a port client in UpstreamCurlBuilds.json, and the two files never share a SHA-256. To add an entry: clone or fetch the port, check out a commit of its master, publish its curl executable (for example 'dotnet publish Curl.Console -c Release -r win-x64 -o %LOCALAPPDATA%\Surl\curl-port\<commit>') into a folder outside both repositories (%LOCALAPPDATA%\Surl\curl-port\<commit>\ on Windows, %HOME%/.local/share/surl/curl-port/<commit>/ elsewhere), then add {platform, path, sha256, commit, publishCommand, published}. A path may name environment variables as %NAME%; they are expanded when the client is located. Re-pinning is an ordinary commit, not an ADR. No client is pinned yet.
